values.title: Update row
values.summary: Update some columns of a row.
values.body:
PATCH

/v1/rows/{table}/{id}

Only the fields you send are changed. Returns the updated row.

### Authorizations

**Authorization string required**

Bearer token. Use a server key or a user access token: Bearer <token>.

### Path parameters

**table string required**

Table name.

**id string required**

Primary key of the row.

### Request body

**…columns object required**

Columns to change.

### Response fields

**id string required**

Primary key.

**… any required**

The row after the update.

### Errors

**401 unauthorized**

The token is missing, expired or revoked.

**404 not_found**

No row exists with this ID in the environment.

**422 validation_failed**

One or more fields are invalid. See error.fields for details.

values.examples:
```
curl --request PATCH \
  --url https://api.tessera.dev/v1/rows/tasks/tsk_2b \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $TESSERA_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"done":true}'
```
